sentences.text: Bo Girds vs behold the lamb is the Matchup of the Week, picked for Closest Finish.
It was an upset, with behold the lamb, 11th before this week, beating 2nd-place Bo Girds.
Germie Bernard was a decider at 12.07 over projection, and without him, that is a loss.
Bo Girds started recent adds Pat Freiermuth and the Indianapolis Colts and got back 2.1 and -0.85.
Across the field, recent add Cleveland Browns finished 3.48 over projection, which is what lucky looks like.
A team called behold the lamb got 11.5 from CeeDee Lamb, under projection, and won regardless.
Tre Tucker is the Game Changer, scoring 24.2 for All You Need Is Love on a 7.58 projection.
Tucker is a margin driver in a 12.95-point win over Pukancun on 3, and without him, that is a loss.
His position rank was 1 of 38 among started WRs, which is not what a 7.58 projection suggested.
Recent add Aaron Rodgers chipped in 17.02 for All You Need Is Love, a lucky free agent pickup that beat its projection.
Pukancun on 3 lost to fall to 1-11, and recent add Cam Skattebo, acquired by trade this week, scored 0.

Davante Adams and Mike Evans are now listed Out, Romeo Doubs is now listed IR, and Brock ‘N’ Roll sits at 6-6, exactly on the cut.

A.J. Brown scored 3.2 and is now listed Questionable (Ankle), which is one more thing on the desk of a 4-8 team.

behold the lamb's own recent add, Cleveland Browns, was lucky at 9.75, and without Germie Bernard, that is a loss.

Recent add Ladd McConkey scored 2.2 and is now listed Out (Concussion), Terry McLaurin is now listed Out (Knee), and free agent add Carolina Panthers chipped in 7.1, so the receiver room at To Infinity and Bijan is a work in progress.
